normalization: Refang [.] to dot and lowercase DNS/hash strings.
Remove PDF-inserted whitespace from hashes; do not change hex digits.
Convert renderer-escaped doubled backslashes to canonical Windows paths and rejoin Music word wrapping.
Preserve leading-dot suffix and redacted/wildcard path semantics in original_value/qualification; emit one matching representative.
Keep duplicate source rows/provenance; unique type/value totals differ from assertion counts.
SHA-256/MD5 catalog kinds are inferred from 64/32 hexadecimal characters in a generic Hash column; matching uses the digest string, not cryptographic verification.
